title: Operator Qualification & Vehicle/Machine/Equipment Integration
objective: Resolve bounded operator-qualification consumption of completed KFR familiarity/transfer evidence for vehicle, machine and equipment domains without allowing familiarity or advisory transfer state to substitute for canonical qualification, progression, permission, ownership, custody, asset or action-authority state.

resolved_contract.qualification_evidence_rule: Only explicit visible canonical-owner qualification evidence may resolve qualified or unqualified. Missing evidence and explicit-unknown evidence remain unknown; incompatible evidence remains incompatible.
resolved_contract.transfer_boundary: KFR-03 familiarity records and KFR-04 advisory transfer/confidence may be referenced for explanation only and can never upgrade, invent or substitute for canonical operator qualification.
resolved_contract.station_authority_rule: Existing visible active VehicleStationGrant authority may be projected separately from qualification. KFR-05 never creates, revokes or mutates station grants and station authority alone does not prove qualification.
resolved_contract.vehicle_platform_rule: MIB-14 vehicle/platform/base/mecha/ship definitions and station compatibility are referenced read-only; MIB-14 configuration validity does not itself qualify an operator.
resolved_contract.equipment_asset_rule: D17 remains sole live Asset/equipment instance and ownership/custody/state authority. KFR-05 may reference asset/definition identity only and never creates or mutates Asset state.
resolved_contract.progression_rule: Progression/Skill and certification owners remain canonical. KFR-05 accepts owner-referenced qualification evidence without creating a duplicate skill, proficiency or certification ledger.
resolved_contract.visibility_rule: Unauthorized qualification evidence, KFR evidence, station grants and target references are filtered before projection, counts, search, explanation, deterministic receipts or AI context; hidden cardinality is not exposed.
resolved_contract.action_authority_rule: A qualified projection is evidence only. Permission, station assignment, ownership, custody and executable action authority remain separate canonical decisions.
resolved_contract.persistence_decision: No durable KFR-05 persistence or duplicate qualification ledger; migration 0022 remains unreserved.
resolved_contract.accessibility: Qualification state, target/station scope, evidence provenance, advisory KFR context and authority separation require accessible nonvisual equivalents.
resolved_contract.validation: Exactly one current KFR-05 Validation Core profile with zero historical predecessor fanout, genuine RED before production, then exact-head self-hosted Linux/Windows and deterministic comparison.

preserved_boundaries: KFR-01 through KFR-04 remain completed_verified with implementation authority retired.
Canonical Character, Progression/Skill, Vehicle/platform, D17 Asset/Equipment, owner-domain and Permission/visibility systems remain authoritative.
Familiarity, transfer eligibility, confidence, station assignment and configuration acceptance do not themselves grant qualification.
KFR-05 introduces no permission grant, action authority, ownership/custody mutation, proficiency/certification mutation, canonical owner mutation, durable persistence or migration 0022.
KFR-06+, ODL-01+, provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.
